facility_fields.id: stable key within ship; future Core entity reference
facility_fields.ship_identity: existing persistent ship identity, bound explicitly by host
facility_fields.logical_location: stable logical location key; no Actor or 3D scene required
facility_fields.occupant_refs: unique existing Core person references; player and NPC use identical rules
facility_fields.capacity: positive integer, or null until configured; null never means unlimited
facility_fields.limitations: configuration-owned constraints; no invented physical capacities
facility_fields.current_activity_ref: existing Core activity reference or null

reservation_fields.facility_ref: existing facility on the same ship
reservation_fields.participant_refs: unique existing person references; no implicit person creation
reservation_fields.activity_ref: activity identity and duration on authoritative Core timeline
reservation_fields.start: campaign_seconds integer >= current Core time when created
reservation_fields.actual_end: Core tick at completion/interruption or null; never moves the world clock backwards

rules: Bind ship identity, location and capacity before making a facility available.
Unavailable, offline, unconfigured or emergency-locked facilities cannot accept use.
Occupancy cannot exceed configured capacity; duplicate identities are rejected.
A facility is exclusive per session: overlapping active/reserved intervals are rejected; adjacent intervals are allowed.
Validate participants against duty, absence and rest agendas; reservations do not grant leave or override authority.
A two-hour session uses end=start+7200 on Core Timeline; all external simulation continues.
External emergency events may interrupt active sessions and cancel conflicting future reservations under authoritative rules.
Recheck availability at activation and each relevant Core event; no player-presence or rendering condition.
Future persistence must store these references in Core; this file is not a mutable campaign state store.
